WAFT Achievements: Scientific Learning System

The Story

Built a scientific learning system that studies itself. Evolved one-pager tool to use Study Gym for self-improvement. Result: System that learns from each generation and documents findings.

Key Accomplishments

Study Gym Integration

  • One-pager now uses Study Gym to analyze each generation
  • Generates first, then studies what happened
  • Documents findings and recommendations
  • Applies corrections based on scientific analysis

Banned Words System

  • BannedWordsSystem for word restrictions
  • Removed "manifesto" → "report" across codebase
  • Global command: waft-one-pager-chat

Evolutionary Features Inventory

  • Mapped ALL evolutionary features (~30% currently used)
  • Identified missing: MUTATE, GYM_EVAL, DEATH, SURVIVAL, Conjugate, selection mechanisms

Scientific Approach

New Workflow:

  1. PREDICT - Generate PDF first
  2. OBSERVE - Count actual pages
  3. STUDY - Use Study Gym to analyze
  4. CORRECT - Apply findings-based corrections
  5. DOCUMENT - Findings and recommendations saved

Tools & Commands

Study Gym - Scientific method learning system

BannedWordsSystem - Word restriction enforcement

SessionReportGenerator - Scientific reports

waft-one-pager-chat  # Global command

Philosophy

> "Physical constellation of crystallized knowledge inside spacetime through the refraction of light"

Output: workefforts/onepagers/[title][date].pdf

Format: 2 pages, printer-friendly, binder-ready, with notes section
